[NRTM.6.3] To investigate a mismatch, `ds_contract_dump_canonical(engine,
&buf, &len)` returns the canonical (RBND.4b) serialization of the loaded
contract: its bytes in a buffer the caller owns and frees with `ds_free`
([IALC.4.3]), and their length. Diff the canonical bytes of two engines. It
returns `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_MISSING` when no contract is loaded, and allocates
nothing then.
